description: The harness check shows out-of-date generated adapters. Can you not keep the too-simple approach and instead create a portable skill to create more practical and descriptive pull requests with an optimal model?

request.original_text: todo esto me dio, no podes crear una skill para crear mejores PR mas practicos y descriptivos? ese ees muy sumble conun modelo optimo
request.canonical_english: The harness check shows out-of-date generated adapters. Can you not keep the too-simple approach and instead create a portable skill to create more practical and descriptive pull requests with an optimal model?

translation.back_translation: El check del harness muestra adapters generados desactualizados. ¿Puedes no mantener el enfoque demasiado simple y en su lugar crear una skill portable para crear pull requests más prácticos y descriptivos con un modelo óptimo?

acceptance_criteria: New portable skill exists at .agents/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter (lowercase name, specific description) and concise body following portable-skill-authoring

Skill provides practical PR workflow: auto-collects git diff, commits, issue/task context, generates descriptive title/body with sections Summary/Changes/Testing/Risks/Checklist, and leverages optimal model per harness routing
Skill supports progressive disclosure via references/ directory (detailed templates, examples) loaded only when needed
python3 scripts/compile_harness.py regenerates adapters without OUT-OF-DATE error (or --check passes) and creates provider wrappers for new skill
Documentation updated where behavior changed (e.g., README or skill index) if needed
